Adding Trabzonspor at 0.15 (#2 on Foot Mercato hijack reporting, replacing San Diego FC in the top 5), trimming Sporting Kansas City 0.14 -> 0.12 and Besiktas 0.08 -> 0.07 (talks halted though Liverpool.com notes 'hasn't happened yet'), and holding Al-Qadsiah at 0.10 (sum 0.81, leaving 19% residual for San Diego FC, Fenerbahce, Galatasaray, Neom SC, or another club).

local_articles.title: Dreyer scores penalty kick to help San Diego FC draw Minnesota United 1-1
local_articles.snippet: Anders Dreyer scored from the penalty spot in the 64th minute as San Diego FC drew Minnesota United 1-1 on Saturday. Minnesota (6-6-6) struck almost immediately when Tomás Chancalay scored in the third minute, finishing from the center of the box off an assist from Wil Trapp to give United a 1-0 lead. San Diego (5-7-6) nearly answered four minutes later, but Marcus Ingvartsen hit the crossbar from the center of the box. Minnesota carried its one-goal advantage into halftime before San Diego found the equalizer midway through the second half. Dreyer converted the penalty with his left foot into the bottom right corner to make it 1-1. Both sides threatened late, as Joaquín Pereyra forced a save from CJ dos Santos in stoppage time before Ingvartsen struck the crossbar for the second time moments later. questions.title: What sentence will Egyptian television presenter Sarah Khalifa receive at trial in her drug-trafficking case?
questions.background: Sarah Khalifa was arrested in Egypt in April 2025 as part of a drug investigation.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The trial court’s announced judgment in the drug-trafficking prosecution stemming from Khalifa’s April 2025 arrest, as confirmed by official court information or reliable reporting from Al-Ahram. Resolution Timing : Resolve when the trial court announces its verdict and sentence. Later appellate decisions and judgments in unrelated cases do not count. Accepted Answer Format : Provide a short legal term identifying the principal penalty imposed, or the court’s disposition if no penalty is imposed. If multiple penalties are imposed, report the most severe.
questions.current_reasoning: Major procedural and legal update from July 8-9 Arabic court reporting (Al-Ahram, Masrawy, Al-Ain, Newsroom): on July 9, the New Cairo Criminal Court adjourned the trial of Sarah Khalifa and 27 co-defendants directly to August 4, 2026 WITHOUT referring the case papers to the Grand Mufti. Under Article 381(2) of Egypt's Code of Criminal Procedure, a criminal court cannot pronounce a death sentence without first referring the file to the Grand Mufti and adjourning weeks later for final sentencing—meaning a death sentence cannot legally be handed down on August 4. Substantively, two further disclosures weaken capital sentencing: (1) Masrawy's indictment summary confirms Khalifa is Defendant #4 (financier/coordinator, plus personal drug-use and unlicensed firearms charges), behind fugitive ringleaders #1 and #2; and (2) defense counsel invoked a Supreme Constitutional Court ruling invalidating scheduling decrees by the Head of the Egyptian Drug Authority. However, the 3-member forensic committee and forensic expert testified on July 8-9 that 2018-2019 Minister of Health decrees explicitly schedule narcotics 'analogues' and confirmed the lab analysis was technically sound, while the court firmly rejected defense procedural challenges. Accordingly, cutting Death penalty sharply 0.28 -> 0.06 (retaining 6% only if the court issues a Mufti referral on Aug 4 for a later verdict), lifting Life imprisonment 0.46 -> 0.56 as the primary statutory penalty under Narcotics Law Art. 33, raising Aggravated imprisonment 0.13 -> 0.19 (Art. 17 clemency or lesser trafficking/firearms counts), Acquittal 0.07 -> 0.11 (Constitutional Court scheduling defense), and Imprisonment 0.04 -> 0.06 (conviction only on drug use/minor counts), with 2% residual.

questions.title: Which prominent RSF field commander will Darfur's governor announce has been killed in western Sudan in early August 2026?
questions.background: The Rapid Support Forces (RSF) are a paramilitary group fighting Sudan's army in a war that began in April 2023.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the RSF field commander whose death in fighting in western Sudan Darfur Governor Minni Arko Minnawi announces during August 1–10, 2026, according to Al Jazeera's reporting. The question concerns the governor's announcement, not independent confirmation of the death. Resolution Date : 2026-08-10 (announcement window: August 1–10, 2026) Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the commander's name, omitting military rank and nickname.
questions.current_reasoning: Key June 30 Africa Defense Forum confirmation (citing Asharq Al-Awsat): former RSF commander Ali 'Al-Safna' Rizqallah defected to the Sudanese Armed Forces in May 2026 (alongside April defector Al-Nour al-Qubba) and received an SAF rank, eliminating Ali Rizqallah (previously 0.07) as an active RSF commander. Meanwhile, on July 26-27 (Al Jazeera, Radio Dabanga, AFP), SAF and Darfur Governor Minni Arko Minnawi's Joint Force launched a major North Kordofan offensive seizing Bara, Jabra El Sheikh, and parts of the Khartoum-El Obeid Export Road as Hemedti ordered frontline reinforcements. Replacing Ali Rizqallah with UNSC-sanctioned RSF Chief of Operations Osman Mohamed Hamid (0.07), aligning Barkallah's spelling to Al Jazeera's exact July 14 reporting ('Abdul Rahman Juma Barkallah'), and retaining a calibrated 56% residual outside the top 5 for other active RSF Darfur/Kordofan field commanders.

questions.title: Which university will house Raja Shehadeh's personal diary archive by August 31, 2026?
questions.background: Raja Shehadeh is a Palestinian writer and lawyer who has kept personal diaries since 1967.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the university confirmed to be physically holding Shehadeh's original personal diary archive by August 31, 2026. Confirmation must come from public statements by Shehadeh or the receiving university, or contemporaneous news reporting establishing that the archive has arrived, rather than merely announcing a planned transfer. Resolution Date : 2026-08-31 Accepted Answer Format : string (institution). Answer with the university's name.
questions.current_reasoning: Palestinian writer and lawyer Raja Shehadeh (turning 75 in July 2026) has kept personal diaries in Ramallah since 1967, and no confirmed university deposit has been announced as of June 24, 2026. The strongest institutional fits are the University of Oxford (whose St Antony's Middle East Centre Archive and Bodleian Library are premier safe UK repositories for Palestinian papers, aligning with Shehadeh's London legal training, UK publisher Profile Books, and Orwell Prize ties), Birzeit University (his local Ramallah alma mater where his wife Penny Johnson is a researcher), the American University of Beirut (his BA alma mater with major Palestinian archival holdings), Columbia University (home to Edward Said's papers), and SOAS University of London. Because dozens of UK, US, and Middle Eastern universities could plausibly acquire the archive, 49% probability mass is left outside the top five.

Lifting Draw sharply 0.20 -> 0.29 on the 4-day Port of Spain rain/thunderstorm forecast (moderated below QPO's 40% historical rate by fragile batting on both sides and overcast seam movement), trimming West Indies 0.51 -> 0.46 and Pakistan 0.29 -> 0.25 (still favoring WI ~65/35 conditional on a result).
